The cockatoo cichlid, Apistogramma cacatuoides, is a small cichlid from the upper Amazon basin, from the Ucayali in Peru to the Solimões in Brazil.
The type locality was originally given incorrectly as Paramaribo, Suriname but this was later amended by Kullander to the "Amazon River basin, between 69°W and 71°W".
